antechambre.title: Last Chamber
antechambre.narrator: Twenty-five metres. On Narhex, that's an eternity — or a second.
antechambre.text:
You advance — episode 6 behind you, everything else ahead.

Your HUD:

**25 m remaining · depth 815 m · lamp 0% · heading 214°**

No beam. Only the **Halloween portal** glow — orange arch carved with runes and pumpkin faces that almost **breathe**.

The chamber is circular. No exit. One path.

The radio, clear:

*« —{{player}}. You made it. — »*

choices.text: Swim straight for the arch — don't stop
Measure the distance — count fin strokes

arc.title: The Living Arch
arc.narrator: A Fableris portal doesn't open — it recognises you.
arc.text:
You reach it.

**825 m**. **15 metres** from the centre.

The arch pulses with your heartbeat — involuntary sync. The water grows **warmer**. **Lighter**.

On the lintel, a Fableris inscription:

*« Whoever descended without their own light may enter. »*

You descended. Your lamp has been **dead** since the cathedral.

Behind you — **heavy** movement. Outside the portal's light. The thing from the wrecks did **not** follow into the nave. It **waited** here.

choices.text: Don't turn — keep your eyes on the arch

gardien.title: Outside the Light
gardien.narrator: What's followed you since the Derelicta doesn't need sight to know where you are.
gardien.text:
The clattering **returns** — muffled by pressure, but there.

In the orange halo, you see only the **shadow**: too long, too supple, edged like the skin glimpsed in the hull jet.

It doesn't charge. It **tightens** the circle — leaving you the portal, taking the rest.

**10 metres** from the centre.

The radio murmurs:

*« —Don't make room for it. Cross. — »*

The arch **widens** — a crack of light, wide as your shoulders. Ready.

choices.text: Throw yourself into the crack — now
Place your palm on the lintel — name your debt

audace_franchir.title: Cross
audace_franchir.narrator: Sometimes running forward is the only courage that counts.
audace_franchir.text:
You propel yourself.

The shadow **lunges** — a rush of water, a brush on your ankle. No bite. Not yet.

You cross the crack.

The world **changes** — pressure dropping, colours screaming, sound becoming **muted music**.

Behind you, a rumble: the portal **closes**. The thing stays on the other side.

You're **inside**.

choices.text: Let the portal current carry you

lucidite_pacte.title: The Debt
lucidite_pacte.narrator: Naming what you owe is sometimes the key you sought without knowing.
lucidite_pacte.text:
You place your hand on the lintel.

You speak — in your head, the Coalition may hear:

*« I am {{player}}. I borrowed the light. I return the descent. »*

The arch **answers** — runes lighting one by one, pumpkins **truly** smiling.

The shadow recedes — not from fear. From **rule**. This portal isn't its domain.

The crack opens **gently**.

You enter without rushing. Water becomes light.

choices.text: Move to the centre of the portal

traversee.title: Crossing
traversee.narrator: Between two worlds, time has no up or down — only passage.
traversee.text:
You swim in the light.

No water — or too much. Images scrolling: the Derelicta sinking, the cliff, relay N-7, the crane, the cathedral, your lamp dying.

**800 m**, the HUD whispers one last time. Then the numbers **vanish**.

A voice — the radio, finally **stable**:

*« —Extraction confirmed. Welcome, {{player}}. — »*

Ahead: a **second** surface. Not Narhex. **Starry** sky. Cold autumn air. Pumpkin and salt.

choices.text: Leave the water — reach the shore

rive.title: The Other Shore
rive.narrator: Surviving Narhex isn't defeating the ocean. It's accepting you won't go back.
rive.text:
You break the surface.

A stone quay. Orange lanterns. Coalition agents in suits — **visible** faces for the first time since splashdown.

Someone hands you a thermal blanket.

Behind you, the portal still pulses underwater — orange mouth slowly closing.

Your HUD, one last line:

**SECTOR 7 MISSION — COMPLETE · max depth 835 m · lamp — · Boldness / Clarity logged**

You breathe. Really breathe.

Narhex stays **out there**. You are **here**.

choices.text: Look one last time at the black water

fin_portail.title: Extraction
fin_portail.narrator: Some missions end with fireworks. This one ends with a breath.
fin_portail.text:
You look at the water.

Still black — but **behind** a closed portal. Not in front of you.

In the distance, glowing pumpkins on the quay. Faint music. The Coalition celebrates Halloween **properly** — knowing what's under the planets it sends you to alone.

The radio, one last time — almost a smile:

*« —Rest, {{player}}. You went down. You came up. — »*

**END — The Depths**

*Thanks for playing · The Depths pack · Fableris*
